title: Hook: Sorry I kept you waiting / AI chips / Sky pays
said: Sorry I kept you waiting. That's AI chips every day waiting for data. And you, Sky, you pay full price to wait.

title: Ofcom 12%
said: Ofcom says traditional TV fell by 12 in a year as people moved to streaming.

title: Netflix and YouTube… and fast
said: Netflix and YouTube already know what you want to watch, so Sky needs that too, and fast.

title: Sky Q voice search
said: Well, you've already started with SkyQ Voice Search.

title: Next step: AI assistant + Imagine asking (one run)
said: Now, the next step is an AI assistant that knows each household. Imagine asking, Sky, make me scared.
notes: ALTERNATE JOKE: 'Sky, make me scared' (latest take)

title: Idle chips / Cast AI 5%
said: Idle chips will still cost you and Cast AI found that enterprise chips average around 5 of use.

title: Sky Sports / Arsenal
said: It's like paying for a whole Sky Sports bundle just to watch Arsenal lose.

title: DDN's Infinia
said: Now DDN's Infinia keeps data flowing to the chips.

title: 99% busy, 75% cost per token
said: And they say customers reach up to 99 busy and cut costs per token by 75%.

title: Canal Plus and Starz
said: Plus, they already work with media companies like Canal Plus and Starz.

title: Ask: the ask is clear / pilot / measure
said: So the arcs is clear. Let DDN run a pilot on the AI behind your voice search or your next assistant. Then measure the values before and after.

title: Ending: don't be the next Blockbuster / Thank you
said: So Sky. Don't be the next Blockbuster. Thank you.
